projects.title: Absorb local assets
projects.outcome: Integrate original experience into owned assets that carry a source, a verification and an owner.

criteria.text: Record a semantic analysis of every source path, with the reason for any deferral.
Merge the selected assets into the existing single source of truth and verify them independently.
Confirm adoption and improvement evidence from real team runs.

projects.title: Operations monitoring migration
projects.outcome: Connect the useful monitoring features of a reference project to real operating data.

criteria.text: See project goals, acceptance criteria and actual work in the monitoring view.
Record whether each reference issue was applied, deferred or replaced, with its evidence.
The user accepts the needed monitoring flow against a real operating scenario.

projects.title: Research-driven self-improvement
projects.outcome: Select evidence-backed improvements from failures, refusals and external research, then verify and apply them.

criteria.text: Collect repeated failures of independent tasks into a research queue without duplicates.
Check each candidate against the single source of truth and primary sources, then fix a bounded improvement design.
Link one full round of implementation, independent verification and knowledge update by evidence.
